back_translation: Hear this word, you cows of Bashan on Mount Samaria, you who oppress the poor and crush the needy, who say to your husbands, 'Bring, that we may drink!'
The Lord GOD has sworn by His holiness: Behold, days are coming upon you when you will be dragged away with hooks, and the last of you with fishhooks.
You will go out through the breaches in the wall, each one straight ahead, and you will be hurled out toward Harmon, declares the LORD.
Go to Bethel and transgress; go to Gilgal and multiply transgression even more! Bring your sacrifices every morning and your tithes every three days.
Burn leavened bread as a thank offering, and loudly proclaim your freewill offerings—for this is what you love, O Israelites, declares the Lord GOD.
I gave you cleanness of teeth—that is, famine—in all your cities, and lack of bread in all your dwelling places; yet you did not return to Me, declares the LORD.
I withheld the rain from you when there were still three months until harvest; I sent rain on one city but not on another. One field received rain, while another field that received no rain withered.
People from two or three cities staggered to another city to drink water, but they were not satisfied; yet you did not return to Me, declares the LORD.
I struck you with blight and mildew; the locust devoured your many gardens and vineyards, your fig trees and olive trees; yet you did not return to Me, declares the LORD.

I sent plague among you as happened in Egypt; I killed your young men with the sword, along with your captured horses; I made the stench of your camps rise into your nostrils; yet you did not return to Me, declares the LORD.
I overthrew some of you as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a firebrand snatched from the burning; yet you did not return to Me, declares the LORD.
Therefore, O Israel, this is what I will do to you, and because I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, O Israel!

For behold, He who forms the mountains and creates the wind, who reveals His thoughts to mankind, who turns the dawn to darkness and treads on the heights of the earth—the LORD God of Hosts is His name.
